metadata.board_title: BOARD OF SECONDARY EDUCATION, A.P. :: VIJAYAWADA\nSSC PUBLIC EXAMINATIONS - MODEL ASSESSMENT
metadata.subject: ENGLISH
instructions: First 15 minutes are allotted for reading the question paper thoroughly.
All answers must be written in the answer booklet provided.
The paper consists of 4 Sections: Section I, II, III and IV.
Internal choice is available in Section IV (8 Marks questions).

sections.title: SECTION - I
sections.instruction: Note: Answer ALL questions. Each question carries 1 Mark.

questions.question: Read the following passage and answer: 'The young seagull was alone on his ledge. His two brothers and his sister had already flown away.' Why was the young seagull alone?
options: B) He was afraid to fly
C) He was waiting for his parents

questions.question: In the phrase 'The wind blew fiercely', what is the part of speech of the word 'fiercely'?
What is the antonym of the word 'Ancient'?
Which of the following is a correctly spelled word?
Change to Passive Voice: 'She wrote a beautiful poem.'
Identify the figure of speech: 'The stars danced playfully in the moonlit sky.'

sections.title: SECTION - II
sections.instruction: Note: Answer ALL questions in 3-4 sentences each. Each question carries 2 Marks.

questions.question: Explain the central theme of the poem 'The Road Not Taken' by Robert Frost.
How did the young seagull's mother trick him into flying?
Write a short note on the importance of discipline in a student's life.
Correct the sentence: 'Each of the students have finished their homework.'

sections.title: SECTION - III
sections.instruction: Note: Answer ALL questions in 5-6 sentences each. Each question carries 4 Marks.

questions.heading: Analyze the following dialogue between a teacher and a student and answer the questions:

rows: Why were you absent yesterday, Rahul?
Sir, I had a severe fever and the doctor advised bed rest.
I hope you are feeling better now. Please submit your medical certificate.
Yes sir, I have it with me. I will submit it by evening.

sub_questions: i) Why was Rahul absent from school?
ii) What did the teacher ask Rahul to submit?

questions.question: Describe the character of Nelson Mandela as portrayed in the lesson 'Long Walk to Freedom'.
Compare and contrast the life of a city dweller and a village dweller.
Write a formal letter to the Principal requesting two days' leave for a family function.

sections.title: SECTION - IV
sections.instruction: Note: Answer ALL questions. Each question carries 8 Marks. Internal choice (A or B) is provided.

choice_a.title: A) Write an essay on 'The Impact of Social Media on Modern Youth'.
choice_a.format: Include introduction, pros and cons, and a balanced conclusion.

choice_b.title: B) Imagine you are the young seagull. Describe your first flight experience in a diary entry.
choice_b.format: Focus on feelings of fear, hunger, and the ultimate joy of flying.

choice_a.title: A) 'True education is that which teaches us how to think'. Elaborate on this statement with examples.
choice_a.format: Discuss the difference between rote learning and critical thinking.

choice_b.title: B) Write a detailed report on a 'Tree Plantation Drive' organized in your school.
choice_b.format: Include date, venue, number of saplings planted, and the chief guest's speech.
